name: Bollinger Bands
description: Bollinger Bands - volatility indicator with upper/lower bands based on standard deviations. Price touching bands may indicate overbought/oversold conditions or breakouts.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: Provide a JSON array of candle objects, not wrapped inside another object. Expected format: [{ "time": 1778076840000, "open": 38.48, "high": 38.48, "low": 38.48, "close": 38.48, "volume": 100, "trades": 1, "vwap": 38.48 }]. The close field is required for Bollinger Bands.

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT).

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d).

fields.label: Period (SMA)
fields.description: Period for middle band SMA. Number of candles required to calculate Bollinger Bands. The candle_data input must contain at least this many bars. For period 20, fetch at least 20 candles first.

fields.label: Standard Deviation Multiplier
fields.description: Standard deviations for bands.5 for low volatility stocks, 2.0 for standard, 2.5-3.0 for highly volatile stocks to avoid false breakout signals.
